supersession.retained_result: The ambient torsion twist cancels the pairing-field holonomy obstruction, but it does not close the full Yukawa vertex.

topology.core_complement: solid torus with H1=Z generated by y

ordinary_charge_two_scalar.finding: The charge-minus-two scalar sees holonomy -1 on the closed complement generator y. An ordinary nowhere-zero covariantly constant condensate therefore cannot coexist with the sterile +i root holonomy.

charge_four_alternative.finding: A charge-four condensate preserves the order-four element but cannot generate the linear Majorana vertex Phi N_c N_c.

torsion_twisted_pairing_scalar.bundle: ambient Z2 torsion line tensor U(1)_(B-L) charge-minus-two line
torsion_twisted_pairing_scalar.finding: The existing ambient torsion sign cancels the charge-two gauge sign. A twisted pairing section can therefore condense consistently and pair the N_c N_c bilinear, whose root holonomy also squares to -1.

revision_of_previous_gate.revised_candidate: U(1)_(B-L) root connection plus an ambient-torsion-twisted charge-minus-two pairing section

scientific_verdict.negative: Minimal B-L with an ordinary charge-two Higgs does not by itself realize the desired order-four root and a nonzero pairing condensate on the full core complement.
scientific_verdict.conditional_rescue: The pairing-field holonomy obstruction cancels if the field is twisted by the ambient Z2 torsion line. The later trilemma proves that the remaining sign is transferred to the Yukawa map.
scientific_verdict.next_gate: Derive this twisted bundle assignment and its potential from the finite algebra or spectral action before treating the B-L branch as coherent.
